hook.text: There are only about 500 certified flavorists in the world. They create the flavors in nearly everything you eat and drink.

buildup.text: Becoming a flavorist takes 7+ years of apprenticeship after a chemistry degree.

discovery.text: A flavorist can recreate any flavor from a palette of about 3,000 raw materials.

twist.text: The most challenging flavors to replicate are cooked meat and fresh fruit. Both involve hundreds of volatiles in precise ratios.

climax.text: A single flavor formula may contain 50–80 ingredients. The recipe is a closely guarded trade secret.

punchline.text: 500 people create the flavors for billions. Seven-year apprenticeships, 3,000 chemicals.

quiz.question: How many certified flavorists exist worldwide?
